title: Quantum Technologies
description: Quantum Technologies that can be useful in modding
body:
This mod is mainly needed for build creators to use it correctly 

The main purpose of the mod is to add various mechanisms.
Example: dragon quantum dust generator, cobblestone quantum generator, and others

This is my second mod, and it's likely to undergo significant changes in the future.

**Dependencies:Thermal exp, draconic, avaritia**
